about: Borders of the map games that need a rule (scripts/data/play/build-borders.mjs). exclaves: borders made by a country's smaller piece on the same continent; they count, and the game explains them. overseas: borders made by an overseas region on another continent; off unless the player turns overseas regions on. links: tunnels and bridges that count as borders (ferries do not). reviewed: differences from the Factbook and Wikidata, checked by hand. skip: map units that are not countries and stay out of the games. add: land borders too small for the 1:50m map.

kaliningrad.en: Russia's Kaliningrad region, cut off from the rest of Russia, borders Poland and Lithuania.
kaliningrad.es: La región rusa de Kaliningrado, separada del resto de Rusia, limita con Polonia y Lituania.

nakhchivan.en: Azerbaijan's Nakhchivan, cut off from the rest of the country by Armenia, borders Turkey.
nakhchivan.es: Najicheván, de Azerbaiyán, separada del resto del país por Armenia, limita con Turquía.

cabinda.en: Angola's Cabinda, north of the mouth of the Congo River, borders the Republic of the Congo.
cabinda.es: Cabinda, de Angola, al norte de la desembocadura del río Congo, limita con la República del Congo.

dubrovnik.en: The Dubrovnik area, cut off from the rest of Croatia by Bosnia and Herzegovina's short coast at Neum (joined by the Pelješac Bridge since 2022), borders Montenegro.
dubrovnik.es: La zona de Dubrovnik, separada del resto de Croacia por la corta costa de Bosnia y Herzegovina en Neum (unida por el puente de Pelješac desde 2022), limita con Montenegro.

gaza.en: The Gaza Strip, apart from the West Bank, borders Egypt.
gaza.es: La Franja de Gaza, separada de Cisjordania, limita con Egipto.

ulster.en: Northern Ireland, part of the United Kingdom, shares the island of Ireland with the Republic of Ireland.
ulster.es: Irlanda del Norte, parte del Reino Unido, comparte la isla de Irlanda con la República de Irlanda.

thrace.en: Turkey's European part, East Thrace, west of the Bosporus, borders Greece and Bulgaria.
thrace.es: La parte europea de Turquía, Tracia Oriental, al oeste del Bósforo, limita con Grecia y Bulgaria.

timor.en: Indonesia's West Timor shares the island of Timor with Timor-Leste.
timor.es: Timor Occidental, de Indonesia, comparte la isla de Timor con Timor Oriental.

newguinea.en: Indonesia's Papua shares the island of New Guinea with Papua New Guinea.
newguinea.es: Papúa, de Indonesia, comparte la isla de Nueva Guinea con Papúa Nueva Guinea.

malaya.en: Peninsular Malaysia, across the sea from Malaysian Borneo, borders Thailand.
malaya.es: La Malasia peninsular, al otro lado del mar de la Malasia de Borneo, limita con Tailandia.

guiana.en: French Guiana, a region of France in South America, borders Brazil and Suriname. It counts only with overseas regions turned on.
guiana.es: La Guayana Francesa, una región de Francia en Sudamérica, limita con Brasil y Surinam. Solo cuenta con las regiones de ultramar activadas.

channel.en: The Channel Tunnel (1994) joins the United Kingdom and France under the sea.
channel.es: El túnel del canal de la Mancha (1994) une el Reino Unido y Francia bajo el mar.

oresund.en: The Øresund Bridge and tunnel (2000) join Copenhagen and Malmö.
oresund.es: El puente y túnel de Øresund (2000) unen Copenhague y Malmö.

kingfahd.en: The King Fahd Causeway (1986) joins Bahrain to Saudi Arabia.
kingfahd.es: La calzada del Rey Fahd (1986) une Baréin con Arabia Saudita.

johor.en: The Johor–Singapore Causeway (1924) joins Singapore to Malaysia.
johor.es: La calzada de Johor a Singapur (1924) une Singapur con Malasia.

kazungula.en: Botswana and Zambia meet for about 150 metres on the Zambezi, crossed by the Kazungula Bridge since 2021.
kazungula.es: Botsuana y Zambia se tocan unos 150 metros sobre el Zambeze, cruzado por el puente de Kazungula desde 2021.

ceuta.en: Spain's cities of Ceuta and Melilla, in North Africa, border Morocco. They count only with overseas regions turned on.
ceuta.es: Las ciudades españolas de Ceuta y Melilla, en el norte de África, limitan con Marruecos. Solo cuentan con las regiones de ultramar activadas.

reviewed.why: Added by hand (add): too small for the 1:50m map.
Ceuta and Melilla are not on the 1:50m map; added as overseas (manual).
A maritime border only: no land between them.
The map draws Somaliland between them, as the political map does.

skip.why: Siachen Glacier: Natural Earth draws this disputed area of Kashmir as its own unit; it is not a country.
